title: User Online Presence & Heartbeat Tracking
learningObjectives: Design heartbeat pings and TTL-based key expiry in Redis for presence detection
Broadcast presence transitions (online, idle, offline) efficiently to followers
Handle connection flapping and brief network drops without false offline alerts
keyTradeoffs: Continuous active heartbeats vs passive request-driven last-seen timestamps
Immediate broadcast of every presence change vs batched delta updates
commonPitfalls: Flooding network sockets by broadcasting presence changes to millions of irrelevant users
Setting heartbeat TTLs too short, triggering spurious offline flickers during momentary packet loss
transferPrompt: How is user presence combined with cursor coordinates in collaborative document workspaces?
